description: This Java class `LayoutAnimation6` extends `Activity` and demonstrates loading installed apps and displaying their icons in a `GridView` with custom adapter `AppsAdapter`.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation6
classes.description: An Android Activity that loads and displays app icons in a grid with animated layout.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter to provide views for each app icon in the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the grid view with the custom adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries installed applications that can handle the main launcher intent and stores the list in mApps.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides a view (ImageView) for each item in the grid, displaying the app icon.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display, limiting to maximum 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the application info for a given position in the list.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
